answer_4.guideline: The results are shown in the last row of Table . We find that humans are significantly better than other baselines, performing around 27% higher on the Logical Contrast set compared to T5-11B on average. Additionally, we see similar trends that humans find negation based perturbations (N-CS) hardest, followed by conjunction (C-CS), and disjunction (D-CS)
